race.comment: Most of these have live claims. LENNOX (5) picked up nicely and beat all but CHILLAXING when they clashed over 2000m at Doomben a fortnight ago. Meets him better at the weights and should be rock hard fit now after three runs back. Looks the testing material. CHILLAXING (4) closed a shade too well for LENNOX last start to make it two wins from his last four. Won't mind the extra 200m and although getting up in the weights is a legitimate chance once again. CAPTAIN MAVERICK (7) has forgotten how to win but continues to race well. Looked a chance but was swamped late in the CHILLAXING race a couple of weeks back. Placed at two of three runs over 2200m so a top three finish is definitely on the cards. MARENARO (6) continued a long run of fine form when in the placings against most of today's chief rivals at Doomben recently. Will handle the longer journey and is not out of contention. FIOPROSPERO (10) has won two of three at Eagle Farm and brings reasonable Sydney midweek form here.
